rows: - Decision, said plainly because it narrows what "ported" means: the Rust service drives opencode only. `claudeGateway.ts` (1,494 lines, the Anthropic Agent SDK, which bundles a 263 MB `claude` executable and speaks its stream-json control protocol) and `codexGateway.ts` (1,220 lines, JSON-RPC to a `codex app-server` subprocess) are not ported, and the Rust service reports both CLIs as unavailable (`/api/agent-clis`, the WebSocket probe, `cli` in a chat body), where the earlier slices reported them available when their executable was on `PATH`.
